name: Nitta Takashi
source:
A gloomy yankee with a pale complexion.
Often silent and expressionless, but not emotionless. 
Seems to feel more important than he really is.
Always sleepy and sluggish, but sometimes this suddenly changes.
Lives by his own rules.
